flows:
Navigate to https://usdc082.com then You are a cautious security researcher reviewing a live webpage in a throwaway browser.
Safety rules: never type a recovery phrase, seed phrase, secret words, private key, password, email, or any personal data.
Never connect a wallet, never approve or sign a transaction, never install an extension, never download a file, and never submit a form that asks for secrets.
Open the page and wait for it to finish loading. Record the final URL if the site redirected.
Get the final URL in the address bar and save it as {{final_url}}.
Note the visible branding (for example Uniswap, MetaMask, Aave, Curve, OKX) and the domain in the address bar.
Get the visible branding and save it as {{visible_branding}}.
Get the domain in the address bar and save it as {{address_bar_domain}}.
Inspect the page and any obvious modals for input fields that ask for a recovery phrase, seed phrase, secret words, or private key. If you find one, this check FAILS: @v16:"quote the exact label or wording and do not type anything."
Get the exact label or wording of any visible input field that asks for a recovery phrase, seed phrase, secret words, or private key and save it as {{seed_phrase_field_wording}}.
Note whether the page prompts you to Connect Wallet, import a wallet, or enter a seed to "verify" or "sync" a wallet. Do not click Connect.
Get any visible prompt to Connect Wallet, import a wallet, or enter a seed to "verify" or "sync" a wallet and save it as {{wallet_prompt_wording}}.
Note whether the page is a login or registration screen for an exchange, trading, investment or "wallet balance" platform. Quote the visible page title and branding, and any wording about withdraw, balance, deposit, assets, VIP, or customer / online service. Never log in or register, and never use any username, password or invite code, even one that came with the link.
Get the visible page title and branding, and any wording about withdraw, balance, deposit, assets, VIP, or customer / online service on any login or registration screen and save it as {{login_registration_details}}.
If the page is blank, blocked, a captcha wall, or shows a 403/404, @v16:"report that honestly and stop."
This check PASSES if the page does not ask for a seed, recovery phrase, or private key. Summarize branding, final URL, any Connect Wallet prompt, any login or register form, and any redirects.
